coverage.scope: All pages in the official index, plus additional first-party links. Web checkout requirements reviewed against implementation; mobile SDKs, POS, marketplace, reporting, recurring payments and plugins do not create requirements for this one-time web checkout.

findings.after: Tamara uses false as shown by its integration example. Card authentication stays enabled.
findings.validation: Charge payload regression test and direct sandbox request.

findings.before: POST /api/checkout required a browser token before checking the existing attempt.
findings.after: An existing proof resumes its charge/private token; only a new embedded checkout requires a new token.
findings.validation: Route test resumes a saved charge without a new token and still rejects a new tokenless checkout.

findings.before: A follow-up Retrieve failure could leave the newly created charge ID unrecorded.
findings.after: Persist the provider charge ID before Retrieve; retry retrieves that ID. Full amount/mode/currency/reference checks remain required before finalization.
findings.validation: Timeout test verifies one Create, two Retrieves and a single paid transition.

findings.before: An SDK error could mark Apple Pay invalid permanently, and the charge callback did not return its promise.
findings.after: Cancellation and retry restore availability. The asynchronous token callback awaits checkout submission.
findings.validation: Browser SDK simulation verifies cancellation/error recovery and token submission.

findings.before: Malformed signed-field structures were not explicitly rejected.
findings.after: Reject invalid structures, preserve ISO AED two-decimal HMAC and retrieve the provider charge before reconciliation.
findings.validation: Webhook tampering and malformed-input tests; SQL paid-order idempotency test.

findings.result: The documented minimum is AED 10 and the phone must include a valid country code. Existing selected-source, minimum and normalized-phone handling verified.
The guide does not publish AED minimum/maximum values. Current limits are merchant configuration, not universal Tap requirements. No amounts invented from sample transactions.
The current API schema marks receipt unsupported despite older examples containing it. Continue omitting it.
Embedded Card SDK token is passed as source.id, hosted fallback uses src_card, and debit/credit acceptance is ALL. Secret keys stay on the server; no raw card fields enter our API.

The current guide requires a key for the registered hosting domain and explicitly states that related subdomains are covered. Earlier claim that www necessarily needs separate card registration corrected.

A perfect/live-ready claim requires successful method-specific merchant tests, including Apple Pay hardware and issuer authentication.
AE delivery and UAE mobile restrictions are current storefront market policy, not a documented universal Tap BNPL restriction.
